_avail.description: Networked Charging Stations for MXW neXt Gooseneck Transmitters
_avail.note: USB 15 V / 3 A power supply (SBC10-USB45WPD) per MXW neXt user guide; dimensions not extracted. Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked). Dimensions not published on product page or in user guide (searched both).

portsSource.note: pp.28-30 NDX hardware callouts; p.83 power supply; dual RJ45 (switched mode) p.72

_avail.notes: Dimensions and weight estimated from MXWNDX8 (H 49.5 x W 371 x D 184 mm, 1.1 kg), not published for MXWNDX8G; powerDrawW 45 = PSU rating of the supplied SBC10-USB45WPD (15 V / 3 A), not a measured draw (MXW neXt user guide p.83); Docking bays (2/4/8 microphones) are not modelled as ports: microphones dock, they are not cabled

ports.label: LAN 1
ports.notes: Dual RJ45, switched mode only; connect to an MXWAPX access point to associate the docking bays with its audio channels; daisy-chain up to 5 NDX

ports.label: LAN 2
ports.notes: Second RJ45 of the switched pair (daisy-chain)

ports.label: USB-C Power In
ports.notes: Locking USB-C PD input, 15 V / 3 A from the supplied SBC10-USB45WPD power supply
